correctness.rationale: The projection has exactly two class means and every grid edge crosses colors, so V(Pf)=e|mean_B-mean_W|. Orient edges black to white. An edge load with black incident sum 1/b, white sum 1/w, max load 1/(2b), certifies |mean_B-mean_W|<=V(f)/(2b). For even mn a spanning Hamiltonian cycle with each edge load 1/(2b) supplies the certificate. For odd mn, the source gives eight explicit Hamiltonian snake paths and nonnegative divergence-preserving flows, mixed with weights (m-1)/(m+n-2) and (n-1)/(m+n-2); its explicit interior/boundary edge formulas show every load <=1/(2b), with corner-edge equality. The corner impulse (degree two and class size b) attains e/(2b), where e=2mn-m-n. Independent fresh exhaustive enumeration of 103,234 nontrivial cuts on seven small grids gives the exact value; independent LP feasibility of capacitated divergence flows succeeds on five odd grids including 7x7. Infinite-grid proof relies on explicit symbolic edge estimates, not these finite LP checks.
residual_risks: LP feasibility for a finite grid does not prove the explicit all-grid snake theorem; the latter is separately reconstructed from the analytic edge formulas.
